title: Tautological assertion P||!P in handle_state_change_unknown_type_is_noop
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:1268: the assertion !state.messages.is_empty() || state.messages.is_empty() is P || !P, unconditionally true regardless of state. It proves nothing. The correct oracle for this test (that an unknown state type is a no-op) is asserting the message count is unchanged from the initial AppState: assert_eq!(state.messages.len(), AppState::new().messages.len(), 'unknown type must not change messages').
